_comment: MEADOWS-VISUAL-PASS round 5. Two camera-centred rings of lit mountain geometry for the Meadows horizon (scripts/world/horizon_ranges.gd): far snowy ranges and nearer forested foothills. Radii keep the back of the far ring inside the gameplay camera's 2000m far plane and the front of the foothills beyond 1500m, past where the corridor's own terrain is still distinct through the fog. Bearings are measured like atan(z, x) of a direction in the XZ plane; 128 degrees puts the hero peak over the spawn outlook toward the north-west. TUNABLE.
_comment_camera_far: Draw-distance floor (F26): graphics_prefs presets set the camera far to 320-900 m, which removed both rings and the far plain. The gameplay camera keeps at least this far plane, the scene's own authored value.
_why_p2_014_r2: F38 P2-014 r2 candidate (local arm only until judged): three depth-separated layers with bluer far tones and non-ridged far faces.
_why_p2_014_r5: r3/r4 flat (5.83, 5.73 vs best 6.10): clearly different approach. A sculpted Meshy hero summit (assets/props/meshy-1020/meadows_hero_summit, provenance there) near the route's vanishing point, with dark rock under crisp snow, replaces the ring's broad hero; r4 foothills kept; denser far-ring rows against the vertical streaks.
